title: NAVIR: Neuromorphic Audio-Visual Speech Recognition for Robust Human-Robot Interaction on Edge Hardware
abstract: arXiv:2609.24391v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Voice-controlled interaction in industrial settings is hampered by acoustic noise, which severely degrades audio-only speech recognition. Audio-visual speech recognition (AVSR) addresses this by fusing lip-motion cues with the audio stream, but state-of-the-art pipelines rely on three-dimensional convolutions, recurrent units, and attention modules that exceed the budget of typical edge devices. We present NAVIR, an end-to-end AVSR system targeting the BrainChip Akida neuromorphic processor, which natively supports only sequential two-dimensional convolutional inference. The pipeline factorises spatial and temporal encoding into separate AkidaNet-based modules: a per-frame visual encoder, a temporal video encoder, and a spectrogram audio encoder, fused by a lightweight predictor head and decoded by constrained beam search. Models are trained with connectionist temporal classification on noise-augmented audio and then fine-tuned with quan

translated_title: NAVIR：面向边缘硬件上鲁棒人机交互的神经形态视听语音识别
translated_abstract: 工业环境中的语音控制交互受到声学噪声的阻碍，这会严重降低纯音频语音识别的性能。视听语音识别（AVSR）通过将唇部运动线索与音频流融合来解决这一问题，但最先进的流水线依赖于三维卷积、循环单元和注意力模块，超出了典型边缘设备的资源预算。我们提出了NAVIR，一个面向BrainChip Akida神经形态处理器的端到端AVSR系统，该处理器原生仅支持顺序的二维卷积推理。该流水线将空间和时间编码分解为基于AkidaNet的独立模块：逐帧视觉编码器、时间视频编码器和频谱图音频编码器，通过轻量级预测头进行融合，并由约束束搜索进行解码。模型在噪声增强的音频上使用连接主义时序分类（CTC）进行训练，随后进行量化感知微调（摘要内容在此处截断）。
tldr: NAVIR是一个专为BrainChip Akida神经形态边缘处理器设计的端到端视听语音识别系统，通过将空间与时间编码分解为仅使用二维卷积的轻量级模块，在嘈杂工业环境中实现了鲁棒的人机语音交互。
en_tdlr: NAVIR is an end-to-end audio-visual speech recognition system designed for the BrainChip Akida neuromorphic edge processor, achieving robust human-robot voice interaction in noisy industrial environments by factorising spatial and temporal encoding into lightweight modules that use only 2D convolutions.
